    num_customers=COUNT(
        Customers.WHERE(

                    CONTAINS(ticker.symbol, 'AMZN') |
                    CONTAINS(ticker.symbol, 'AAPL') |
                    CONTAINS(ticker.symbol, 'GOOGL') |
                    CONTAINS(ticker.symbol, 'META') |
                    CONTAINS(ticker.symbol, 'NFLX')

            ) == 1
        )
    )
)

3. Uses `HAS()` to check if the customer has at least one transaction where the ticker symbol contains any of the FAANG company symbols
4. Uses `CONTAINS()` to check if the ticker symbol includes the FAANG identifiers
5. Combines the FAANG conditions with `|` (OR) operator
6. Counts the distinct customers meeting both criteria using `COUNT()`
